reviewer: Codex child /root/mesh_audit; did not author builder/tests, deriver or calibration data
scope: Independent read-only audit and actual local Blender tests/rebuilds of the frozen builder, plus source/AST/PNG/provenance review of the executed fixed calibration deriver/data. No paid CLI calls, no implementation edits, no changes to prior review records or original real-run artifacts.

resolved_findings.finding: Genuine n2-photo plan produced two disconnected561-vertex trouser leg shells when belt_height=.515 clipped away the seat. The provider plan was valid; rejecting its split mesh was correct.
resolved_findings.fix: Trouser waist now derives from canonical hip seat independently from decorative/default belt height. The original plan remains byte-identical and the one-component guard remains strict.
resolved_findings.verification: Independent unchanged n2 source SHA107c3a5b… rebuild passes with every part closed; final suite includes exact photo and low-belt topology coverage.

resolved_findings.finding: Actual n2 diagnostic2 closed shoes left4144/14010 masked forefoot BODY vertices outside each shoe, up to14.196mm.
resolved_findings.fix: Fixed closed footwear uses bounded support-ring geometry based on actual morphed feet, retaining forefoot coverage after subdivision.
resolved_findings.verification: Independent three-ray inside test on final own n2 GLB finds0/14010 outside each side at approximately0.5mm tolerance, using a mask that excludes the heel/ankle opening.

resolved_findings.finding: Initial calibration deriver imported by module name while hashing an arbitrary builder argument, and could overwrite an existing module silently.
resolved_findings.fix: Deriver requires canonical basename and exact imported __file__, captures source hashes before imports, rechecks source/generator around rows and output, and refuses existing module unless explicit --replace-module.
resolved_findings.verification: Executed final origin binds current exact generator/builder/helpers/module/PNG; generated module is one literal and all nine sheet panels equal actual render files pixel for pixel.

verified_design: Model inputs remain bounded JSON data; optional trouser_color/footwear_color are null-or-RGBA and age_blend is null-or-finite0..1. Fresh strict schema requires these nullable keys, while absent/null legacy fields preserve prior defaults during expansion without modifying original plan data.
All age deformation paths use shared resolve_age_blend. Receipt records requested/effective age coefficients, while source-plan hash and original parameter object remain unchanged.

Garment waistband follows measured pre-thickness outer surface sections; rolled cuffs follow actual closed hem loops. Layered wrap front and upper-chest inner panel are real thickened geometry, not painted seams.

Canonical BODY stays one closed surface with no skin VDB, head/hand splicing or external component filtering. Generic organic fusion retains its bounded connected/manifold checks. Body/accessory components, positive volume and nondegenerate triangles remain mandatory.

Actual post-modifier limits remain2M triangles/1M vertices/64MiB GLB; fixed source plan/grid budgets and output no-overwrite checks remain enforced. No arbitrary region dropping or weaker topology guard was introduced.

Actual GLB position counts and index triangle totals match final receipts; requested/fallback independent trouser and footwear colors are present in the exported material factors within float32 tolerance.

Calibration renders three fixed ordinary-data baselines with no target image, model or network. Full body/front face/+X profile cameras match the builder axis transform and fixed1.8m/7.5-head controls. GLB geometry is exported before the clay view-layer rendering override.

Calibration Python module contains exactly one AST assignment of a literal CALIBRATION value. Decoded PNG, dimensions, source hashes, controls and actual receipt hashes match the executed artifact/origin; no module execution was used for this review.
